'Very hot' = felt temperature 35 °C or more. 'Far' = more than 500 m (≈ 6 min) walk to the nearest public drinking fountain. Pale squares: nobody lives there.
ℹ️ What am I looking at?
Where is it very hot and a long walk to the next public drinking fountain – and do people live there? Walking distances follow real footpaths and streets (OpenStreetMap), not a straight line. Grey squares: no walking route could be calculated (e.g. the Zoo, or gaps in the path data).
